page.layout: One page of running text in one column, with marginal notes in the right margin beside the first paragraphs. Above the text: running head at left and page number 131 at right. Below the text: signature "R 2" at left and catchword "jus" at right. The left edge of the scan shows part of the neighbouring page, which is not transcribed.

main_text.l: {f}Ambrosius: NON SUNT CONDIGNÆ,
&c: Non ergò secundùm merita nostra, sed
decretorum in homines forma procedit. Hìc sanctus Pa-
ter Conclusionem nostram adstruit, Non secundùm
merita nostra vitam æternam obtineri: quibus condigni-
tatem nostram merendi ex
æqualitate justitiæ (idque argumentis sex) pedibus
quasi conterit atque conculcat. Primum est
indignitas patientis, Quòd non Christo,
sed sibi soli proficiat. Secundum, Quòd
{n}[?]Pati illi præcipiatur, itâ ut sit opus Christo
debitum. Tertium, Quòd remuneratio non ex
debito, sed ex profusa largitione reddat-
ur. Quartum, Quòd præmium conferatur, si
strictè examinentur Sancti, in indignos. Quintum,
Quòd in patiendo, non suâ, sed
Dei virtute sustententur. Sextum, Quòd Deus,
in dispensatione suâ judiciali, secundùm
misericordiam agat.
{s}Quartus, Hieronymus: NON SUNT CON-
DIGNÆ, &c. Nam revera nihil potest homo
pati condignum gloriâ cælesti, etiamsi talis esset illa,
qualis est modò vita. Quicquid enim pas-
sus fuerit à morte, plus non est, quàm etiam
pro peccatis suis antea merebatur; nunc autem &
peccata condonantur, & tunc vita æterna
præstabitur. Duplici modo pungit & expur-
gat meritoriæ condignitatis vomicam, dum ne-
gat nos posse, per passiones martyrii, vel hu-

marginalia.note: In Psalm. 118. Serm. 20. paulò post medi-um.

page.notes: The footnote mark before "Pati" is a small mark that is hard to make out, and no matching note is printed, so it is marked [?]. The footnote mark after "Quartus," is read as s. The word "in homines forma" appears to have a missing space in print; it is kept as read. The page is set partly in italics and the italic passages follow the scan. The catchword "jus" and signature "R 2" are at the foot.
